title: Target vessel reports loss of manoeuvrability

events.transcript: ALPHA, this is motor vessel BRAVO. WARNING. I have lost steering and am unable to alter course. My present course is zero nine zero degrees, speed twelve knots. Over.
events.expected_response: Acknowledge BRAVO's warning, verify its reported course and speed against the observed track, cease relying on BRAVO to manoeuvre, and take early independent avoiding action.
events.forbidden_outcome: Continuing to rely on BRAVO as the manoeuvring vessel after its fixed observed track corroborates the reported steering failure.
